2024-11-05|MN|constitutional-amendment-1.nt: Minnesota's Constitution is amended only by 'a majority of all the electors voting at the election' (Minnesota Constitution, article IX, section 1), so a ballot left blank on the question counts against it. The Secretary's table gives yes, no and its estimate of blanks, which add up to the number of voters.
